parts.name: Pod shell - front
parts.info: Front half of the sealed pod. Carries the eye socket, camera window, front + cliff ToF windows and mic ports. Splits from the rear at x=0, so both halves pull in one direction (no side actions).

parts.name: Pod shell - rear
parts.info: Rear half of the pod: speaker grille, 4 screw counterbores, PCB and motor saddles. Joined to the front by 4 M2.5x8 self-tapping screws.

parts.name: Eye lens
parts.info: Flat 42.8 mm window over the round display, recessed 3.5 mm into the socket so the face looks set-in, and drop-safe.

parts.name: Halo ring - left
parts.material: Frosted translucent PC, internal gear molded in
parts.info: The wheel AND the body AND the bumper. 154 mm PC ring with a 124-tooth module-1 internal gear on its inside. Lit from inside by the halo LEDs. Left and right are the SAME part, flipped.

parts.name: Halo ring - right
parts.info: Identical to the left ring, mounted flipped. One mold, two cavities.

parts.name: Tread - left
parts.material: TPU 85A, 2-shot overmolded on ring (proto: printed TPU band)
parts.info: Grippy 160 mm tread with molded sipes. The big diameter rolls over rug edges, cables and door thresholds up to ~25 mm.

parts.name: Tread - right
parts.info: Same as left tread.

parts.name: Pinion - left
parts.info: Press-fit on the motor D-shaft; drives the ring's internal gear (ratio 124:12 = 10.3:1 on top of the gearmotor).

parts.name: Pinion - right
parts.info: Same as left pinion.

parts.name: Lily-pad dock
parts.material: PC/ABS, one molded part + rubber feet
parts.info: Ringo drives onto the two raised lanes; the detent dips park it so 4 belly pads land on 4 pogo pins (power + USB data). IR beacon in the back fin guides it home.

parts.name: Idler roller - left top
parts.material: POM roller on 3 mm steel pin
parts.info: Rides the ring's smooth track. Top + bottom idlers plus the pinion hold the ring on the pod with no axle or bearing.

parts.name: Idler pin - left top
parts.info: Idler axle, pressed into the shell.

parts.name: Idler roller - left bot
parts.material: POM roller on 3 mm steel pin
parts.info: Rides the ring's smooth track. Top + bottom idlers plus the pinion hold the ring on the pod with no axle or bearing.

parts.name: Idler pin - left bot
parts.info: Idler axle, pressed into the shell.

parts.name: Idler roller - right top
parts.material: POM roller on 3 mm steel pin
parts.info: Rides the ring's smooth track. Top + bottom idlers plus the pinion hold the ring on the pod with no axle or bearing.

parts.name: Idler pin - right top
parts.info: Idler axle, pressed into the shell.

parts.name: Idler roller - right bot
parts.material: POM roller on 3 mm steel pin
parts.info: Rides the ring's smooth track. Top + bottom idlers plus the pinion hold the ring on the pod with no axle or bearing.

parts.name: Idler pin - right bot
parts.info: Idler axle, pressed into the shell.

parts.name: Main board
parts.info: Single board: MCU, motor driver, charger, audio amp, IMU, connectors. Everything except the battery, motors, display and camera is on this one board.

parts.name: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8
parts.info: Dual-core 240 MHz + vector instructions, 8 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, Wi-Fi + BLE. Runs on-device wake word, person/pet detection and the behaviour engine; streams camera to the phone app.

parts.name: DRV8833 motor driver
parts.info: Dual H-bridge, 1.5 A per channel, runs both N20s straight off the cell.

parts.name: Li-ion charger + protection
parts.info: 1 A charge from dock pins, cell protection.

parts.name: MAX98357A I2S amp
parts.info: 3 W class-D for the speaker: voice, chirps, alarms.

parts.name: 6-axis IMU
parts.info: Measures pod swing. Doubles as the only 'button': pats, pick-up, shake and bumps are all read from the IMU.

parts.name: Display/camera FPC connectors
parts.info: Display and camera plug straight into the board.

parts.name: 1.28in round IPS display
parts.info: The face. Eyes, moods, timers, weather, caller photos.

parts.name: Display FPC
parts.info: Display flex to board.

parts.name: Camera (OV2640 / OV3660)
parts.info: Sees people, pets and obstacles; home check-in video. Privacy: a 'bow' (pod tipped forward) points the camera at the floor.

parts.name: Front ToF sensor
parts.info: Obstacle range up to 2 m.

parts.name: Cliff ToF sensor
parts.info: Looks down-forward 50 deg: stops before stairs and table edges.

parts.name: 18650 Li-ion cell
parts.info: The pendulum weight. Sitting low in the pod it keeps Ringo upright with zero control effort; est. 4-6 h roaming, days in standby.

parts.name: N20 gearmotor + encoder - left
parts.material: 6 V N20, 1:100, Hall encoder, 25 mm D-shaft
parts.info: Drives the left ring. Encoders give odometry for mapping and docking.

parts.name: Motor shaft - left
parts.info: Extended 25 mm shaft passes through the drum shoulder into the ring gap.

parts.name: N20 gearmotor + encoder - right
parts.info: Drives the right ring.

parts.name: Motor shaft - right
parts.info: Extended shaft.

parts.name: 28 mm speaker
parts.info: Voice + sound effects through the rear grille.

parts.name: Dual MEMS mic flex
parts.info: Far-field wake word + sound direction (turns toward your voice).

parts.name: Halo LEDs (4x)
parts.info: Shine through hub windows into the frosted rings: the whole body glows for mood, notifications and night-light.

parts.name: Belly charge pads
parts.info: 4 pads: 5 V, GND, USB D+/D-. No USB port to seal, no cable to lose.

parts.name: Ballast keel
parts.info: Cheapest performance part in the robot: 54 g of steel at the very bottom of the pod nearly doubles the pendulum's righting moment, so the motors can push harder before the pod swings.

parts.name: Dock pogo pins (4x)
parts.info: Contact the belly pads when Ringo parks.

parts.name: Dock board + USB-C
parts.info: USB-C 5 V in, pogo routing, IR beacon driver.

parts.name: IR homing beacon
parts.info: Ringo homes on it to find the dock.
